what: What did each of Lunenburg's capital project funds (articles funded outside the general fund) appropriate, spend and carry forward in FY1996?
why: `report-capital-projects` reads a CAPITAL PROJECT FUND schedule by article from the 2001-2010 reports (2001 p66-67, 2010 p67). The 1996 annual town report prints no such schedule: the combined balance sheet carries a CAPITAL PROJECT FUND column (p47, cash and cash investments $340,491.82) but no page lists the articles behind it. The text of every page (101 of 104 with words) was searched for capital project, project fund and projects and returned only the balance-sheet column heading (p47), the Capital Planning Committee's prose (p13: `The FY'96 Capital Plan allocation was $287,140.00. Monies spent was $279,998.12`) and the mosquito control project (p14) (sources/data/report-tables/1996/). — closes: the Town Accountant's FY1996 capital projects fund ledger (appropriated, expended, balance by article).

what: What did each item of Lunenburg's FY1997 capital plan cost?
why: `capital-plans` holds item-by-item costs. The 1996 annual town report prints the FY1997 plan only as article totals with the items named in prose: Article 10 refers to a `Capital Expenditure/Improvement/Maintenance Budget FY97` that is not printed, Article 11 ($200,000; VOTED $100,000 borrowed for a front end loader and $100,000 raised) and Article 12 ($149,650) list items without amounts (p84), and the Capital Planning Committee's report gives one figure, `The FY'97 Capital Plan Articles passed at the Annual 1996 Town Meeting were for a $210,000.00` (p13). Text searched on every page for capital plan, capital expenditure and capital improvement (sources/data/report-tables/1996/). — closes: the Capital Planning Committee's `Capital Expenditure/Improvement/Maintenance Budget FY97` as presented to the May 11, 1996 Annual Town Meeting.

what: What were the town's non-union salary grades and step rates for FY1997?
why: `salary-schedule` and `report-classification-plan` read Schedule A from the 2010 report and FY2011 onward. The 1996 annual town report prints neither: its text was searched on every page with words (101 of 104) for salary schedule, classification plan, schedule A, grade, step and pay scale and returned only the DEGREE/STEP column of the school wage list (p96-102, each employee's own step, not a rate table), enrollment by grade (p38) and two Salary Administration Plan by-law articles with no rates (p82, Articles 5 and 6) (sources/data/report-tables/1996/). — closes: the Salary Administration Plan schedule of grades and steps in force for FY1997, from the Town Clerk or the Personnel Board.

what: How many weighing and measuring devices did the Sealer test in 1996, and what did sealing bring in?
why: `report-weights-measures` holds the Sealer's device counts and fees from the 2010 report. The 1996 annual town report prints no Inspector of Weights & Measures report: its text was searched for weights, sealer, sealing, devices, scales and pumps and returned only the appointment (p10), the receipts line SEALING FEES $801.00 (p48), the appropriation line Inspector Weights & Measures (p53), the omnibus line 244 WEIGHTS/MEASURES (p83), the Assessors' tax-bill line (p45) and the inspector's wage (p95) (sources/data/report-tables/1996/). — closes: the Sealer of Weights and Measures' 1996 annual report to the Division of Standards.

what: How much of Lunenburg's debt at 30 June 1996 sat inside the debt limit, and how much outside it?
why: `outstanding-debt` reads this from the outstanding-debt summary the FY2011-FY2025 reports print. The 1996 annual town report prints its bonded indebtedness issue by issue (p65) and a repayment schedule (p66) whose interest lines carry `INTEREST (EXEMPTED)` for the two school remodeling issues, but no summary by purpose and no debt-limit split: its text was searched for debt limit, outstanding debt, indebtedness and exempt and returned only those headings, the index line (p5) and the newsletter (p61) (sources/data/report-tables/1996/). — closes: the Town's FY1996 Statement of Indebtedness as filed with the Division of Local Services.
